note: Brand and domain routes, each seeded from a measured run. A row is added by a benchmark, never by an opinion. Override order is property > domain > brand > default.

default.why: the lane that reached 21 of 30 properties across six buckets in pilot-002

MARRIOTT.why: 5/5 fetched, 100% precision and 100% critical recall across three pilots

HILTON.why: 3/3 fetched at 100% recall once the brand container was made to COMPETE with the generic walk instead of pre-empting it

IHG.why: 4/5 fetched at 100% precision and 62% recall; the most expensive lane measured at $2.71 for five properties, so its telemetry is worth watching

WYNDHAM.why: 5/5 fetched at 100% recall once div.policy-items.pet-policy was read via textContent; the page never paints it and innerText returns empty

CHOICE.why: the Browser API was refused 14 times in 15 attempts and captured nothing; the Web Unlocker fetched 5/5. Browser API is NOT a fallback here because it is the lane that measurably does not work

SONESTA.why: generic walk; part of the MIXED bucket measured at 2/5 in pilot-002

RED_ROOF.why: generic walk. Its identity gate needs the alias mechanism: the brand names this property Cleveland Airport-Middleburg Heights where the record says Red Roof Inn Middleburg Heights

ESA.why: generic walk; policy sits behind a services-and-policies modal that the disclosure pass opens

www.choicehotels.com.why: the same measurement as the CHOICE brand row, pinned to the domain so a property whose brand is unknown still avoids the lane that does not work

excluded_brands.HYATT: premium domain under the current Bright Data plan, and behind Kasada; excluded on cost, not on capability
excluded_brands.BEST_WESTERN: premium domain under the current Bright Data plan
